name: tr-eli-mcp
description: Turkish legislation with verifiable citations, from the Ministry of Justice's official legislation service (Bedesten API behind mevzuat.gov.tr): search laws and other legislation, the table of contents and the content of an act, with resolvable identifiers. Every answer carries the official source, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to the Ministry of Justice; nothing goes to MateMatic.
